scenario: [LEXP.6.1] `len(<Json>)` is the ARRAY LENGTH at runtime. Asserts the VALUE. Pins the lowering — `len` over a json-path chain renames the FN_JSON_PATH call to FN_JSON_LEN, so the count is taken from the array itself and never from its serialised text. The three-element array is chosen so the two wrong answers are BOTH excluded and distinguishable: the serialised text `[10, 20, 30]` is 12 characters, and a discarded-contents projection answers 0. A vector asserting only `> 0` or `> 3` would pass on the serialised length.
rules_ds:
schema Payload scope logical:
    body: Json key

rule len_counts_elements:
    Payload p where len(p.body.items) == 3
->
    log critical "len-3"
